  )
),
wage_2017 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wage
  FROM (

    UNION ALL

    UNION ALL

    UNION ALL
    SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q4` WHERE area_fips = '42003'
  )
),
cpi_1998 AS (
  SELECT value as cpi_val FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND year = 1998 AND period = 'S02'
),
cpi_2017 AS (
  SELECT value as cpi_val FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
  WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' AND item_name = 'All items' AND year = 2017 AND period = 'S02'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w2.avg_wage - w1.avg_wage, w1.avg_wage) * 100, 2) as wage_growth_pct,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c2.cpi_val - c1.cpi_val, c1.cpi_val) * 100, 2) as cpi_growth_pct
FROM wage_1998 w1, wage_2017 w2, cpi_1998 c1, cpi_2017 c2
